title: Dot Product and Its Applications
topicTitle: Dot product (scalar product) and its applications
notes: **Geometric meaning:** measures how much two vectors align. $\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = |\vec{a}|$ times projection of $\vec{b}$ on $\vec{a}$.
**Work:** $W = \vec{F} \cdot \vec{d} = Fd\cos\theta$. Only the component of force along displacement does work.
